1.title: Chris Pappas Defeats Progressive Challenger in New Hampshire Senate Primary
1.summary: Mr. Pappas, a moderate Democrat who has served four terms in the House, will face former Senator John E. Sununu, the Republican nominee, in November.

2.title: John E. Sununu Wins Republican Senate Primary in New Hampshire
2.summary: The general election race to replace Jeanne Shaheen, a Democrat, could help determine control of the U.S. Senate.

3.title: Dueling Court Rulings Leave Missouri’s Congressional Races in Chaos
3.summary: After losing in two courts and winning in another, Missouri officials said they planned to forge ahead with using a congressional map that was redrawn to benefit Republicans.

4.title: US slaps import ban on Canadian alcohol and other goods
4.summary: It is the latest escalation in a trade war between the two countries, and comes as Canadian retaliatory tariffs on US goods come into force.

5.title: Meta continues to run ads promoting child sexual abuse material in India - report
5.summary: The report follows a BBC Eye investigation that found Instagram running paid ads promoting such material in India.

6.title: 'Constantly on my mind' - 9/11 agony goes on for bereaved, 25 years on
6.summary: As the 25th anniversary approaches, the wait for the alleged mastermind of the attack to be put on trial goes on.
